bibliographic.title: The Stolen Page
bibliographic.author: DrOctothorpe
bibliographic.description:
A youth, in once-fine raiment gone to rags, crouches in a dirty alley and from their threadbare coat pulls out a lustrous, half-torn vellum page…

A narrative puzzle in which you talk back and forth with a page torn from a magical book. Created for NeoTwinyJam2026.

Word count: 319 (including hints and title but not credits)

Warning! The puzzle aspect turned out fairly challenging but it was not designed as a brain-cruncher. The in-game hints are helpful and not spoilers  If you try stuff and muddle through, you're playing in the spirit it was created.

If you find sentences that you think should have had a response and didn't, please email me at metaphysician@gmail.com and let me know!
